title: Push for the UAP Disclosure Act in the NDAA

tellings.quote: us trying to pass the UAP Disclosure Act language on the National Defense Authorization Act.

plain: A US congressman named Eric Burlison says that between 2023 and 2025 he took part in a push to add wording from the UAP Disclosure Act into the National Defense Authorization Act, the big yearly law that sets the US military's budget and rules. UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs, and the Disclosure Act was a bill meant to force the release of government records about them. He names fellow members of Congress Tim Burchett and Anna Paulina Luna as part of the effort, which, if it worked, would put legal pressure on the government to reveal what it knows.
